name: @meir-labs/skill-loop-engineering
description: The meirlabs loop-engineering skill — drive a big goal end-to-end as a multi-agent orchestrator. Fan out as many haiku/sonnet/opus subagents as the goal needs, pick the model tier per task, plan first and get the plan approved before any large fan-out, add adversarial-verify passes for anything that must be right, and never auto-send anything outward-facing. npx installs it into .claude/skills.
author: Meir Rosenschein
